integrity: The sharp window is derived by exact factorization of the first four FISTA iterates and replayed at high precision. The primary FISTA paper was inspected in full, and the closest monotonicity/oscillation literature and targeted published-finding corpus searches were compared. Independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Finite-horizon classification for one invariant eigendirection of a smooth two-curvature quadratic under the original constant-majorization FISTA recurrence. It does not classify all later objective rises, backtracking variants, or nonsmooth active-set effects; a practical stationarity test would stop at the exact-hit resonance.
title: A sharp scalar fourth-iterate nonmonotonicity window for original FISTA
